extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and applicants preparing revised amendments/replies to USPTO Office actions
extracted.subtask_description: A sample format and procedural guidance for preparing a Revised Amendment (reply to an Office action) for a U.S. patent application, showing how to present specification edits, claim listings, drawing changes, remarks/arguments, attachments, and signature information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required header/application identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Appl. No.  Applicant  Filed  TC/A.U.  Examiner  Docket No.  Customer No.  Confirmation No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the standard application-identifying fields at the top of the amendment (application number, applicant name, filing date, Technology Center/Art Unit, examiner name, docket number, customer number, confirmation number). Example header fields are shown in the sample format.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to Office action and explicit amendment statement
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to the Office action of October 16, 2003, please amend the above-identified application as follows:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly identify the Office action being replied to (by date) and state that the submission is an amendment in response to that Office action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table of contents for amendment sections (section pagination)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to the Specification begin on page 2 of this paper.  Amendments to the Claims are reflected in the listing of claims which begins on page 3 of this paper.  Amendments to the Drawings begin on page 4 of this paper and include both an attached replacement sheet and an annotated sheet showing changes.  Remarks/Arguments begin on page 5 of this paper.  An Appendix including amended drawing figures is attached following page 5 of this paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear table-of-contents-like notice at the front of the amendment indicating on which page each amendment category (specification, claims, drawings, remarks/arguments, appendix/attachments) begins and note attached replacement/annotated sheets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification amendment format (replace/add/delete by paragraph number)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please replace paragraph [0021] with the following amended paragraph: ...  Please replace paragraph [0045] with the following amended paragraph: ...  Please add the following new paragraph after paragraph [0075]: [0075.1] ...  Please delete the paragraph beginning at page 2, line 4, which starts with 'Under normal circumstances'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When amending the specification identify exact paragraph numbers (in brackets) and either provide the full replacement text, the new paragraph text with its bracketed number, or a precise deletion instruction referencing page and line. Use bracketed paragraph numbers and show the amended language verbatim in the amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete claim listing replaces prior versions
rubrics_metrics.description: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:  Listing of Claims:  Claims 1-5 (canceled)  Claim 6 (previously presented): A bucket with a handle.  Claim 7 (withdrawn): A handle comprising an elongated wire.  Claim 8 (withdrawn): The handle of claim 7 further comprising a plastic grip.  Claim 9 (currently amended): A bucket with a green blue handle.  Claim 10 (original): The bucket of claim 9 wherein the handle is made of wood.  Claim 11 (canceled)  Claim 12 (not entered)  Claim 13 (new): A bucket with plastic sides and bottom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a full, self-contained listing of claims as they are to stand after the amendment, and explicitly state that this listing supersedes all prior claim listings. For each claim indicate its status (canceled, withdrawn, not entered, previously presented, currently amended, original, new) and include the claim text where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim status labeling (canceled/withdrawn/new/etc.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use explicit labels in the claim listing to convey each claim's procedural status. Typical labels include 'canceled', 'withdrawn', 'not entered', 'previously presented', 'currently amended', 'original', and 'new'. These labels inform examiner record-keeping and prosecution history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings amendment procedure and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: The attached sheet of drawings includes changes to Fig. 2.  This sheet, which includes Fig. 1-2, replaces the original sheet including Fig. 1-2.  In Figure 2, previously omitted element 13 has been added.  Attachment: Replacement Sheet  Annotated Sheet Showing Changes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When altering drawings supply a replacement drawing sheet and an annotated sheet showing changes, state which original sheet is being replaced, identify added or changed element numerals, and attach the replacement and annotated sheets to the amendment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remarks/Arguments must explain nature and basis of amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: In the specification, the paragraphs [0021] and [0045] have been amended to correct minor editorial problems.  The new paragraph [0075.1] added after paragraph [0075] discusses in general terms the features taken from Example 4.  In amended Figure 2, the previously omitted element numeral 13 has been added.  Claims 6-10 and 12-13 remain in this application.  Claims 1-5 and 11 have been canceled.  Claims 7 and 8 have been withdrawn.  The examiner has acknowledged that claims 6 and 9-10 are directed to allowable subject matter.  Claim 7-8 have been withdrawn as the result of an earlier restriction requirement.  Claim 13 adds an additional feature from Example 2 in the specification.  In view of the examiner’s earlier restriction requirement, applicant retains the right to present claims 7-8 in a divisional application … Applicant respectfully requests that a timely Notice of Allowance be issued in this case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a Remarks/Arguments section that (a) describes what amendments were made and why (editorial corrections, incorporation of examples, overcoming rejections), (b) identifies claim statuses and examiner acknowledgements (e.g., allowable subject matter), (c) explains procedural matters (restriction/divisional rights), and (d) includes a request (e.g., for Notice of Allowance) where appropriate. Be precise and link claim changes to specification support or examiner communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explicit request for desired PTO action
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant respectfully requests that a timely Notice of Allowance be issued in this case.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If appropriate, include an explicit, polite request for PTO action (e.g., issuance of a Notice of Allowance) at the conclusion of the amendment/remarks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and practitioner identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Respectfully submitted,  SMITH, JONES & BROWN  By_________________________  Martin J. Gallagher  Reg. No. 99,999  Tel.: (101) 555-2345
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a signature block with the submitting attorney/agent's name, registration number, firm name (if applicable), and contact telephone number. Signature (or authorized signature line) should be present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachments listing and appendix reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Attachment: Replacement Sheet  Annotated Sheet Showing Changes  An Appendix including amended drawing figures is attached following page 5 of this paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List all attachments and appendices in the amendment. Indicate where appended material appears (e.g., 'attached following page 5') and ensure attached replacement/annotated sheets and any appended figures are present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pagination and page count identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Page 1 of 7 ... Page 2 of 7 ... (each page is numbered and total page count appears)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number amendment pages and indicate total number of pages (e.g., 'Page 1 of 7') to help ensure completeness and to reference content by page in deletion/replacement instructions.
